propositions: Axis `divergent_implementation` is mis-calibrated: fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and is never revisited since born in d487060b5; 90% of 1,307 omitted-scope findings grade it `none` despite being the class it exists to describe.

Plan grading schema must migrate `divergent_implementation` from ordinal `none|low|medium|high` to closed `Literal["none", "contradicts_reality", "omits_required_site", "incomplete_enumeration"]` with floor-graded and non-flooring contributions respectively.
`impact_plan` resolution of the axis must bypass generic `_SEV01` map and use new `DIVERGENCE_GRADE01` map keyed on kind; structural refactor required to prevent silent degradation to 0.0 scoring.

Proposed high-cost LLM-based calibration (Fix 2 / `prod_impact` floor) is rejected because it violates loop-termination constraint: it rescues semantically unbounded severity band that recurs unchanged across remediation rounds, unlike Fix 1's remediable divergence class.
ADR 0054 narrows ADR 0036 A/B permissibility to zero-marginal-cost forms only: corpus replay and dogfood observation; purpose-built LLM eval suites and bulk re-review rejected on cost grounds.

All fixtures, prompts, and version-tagged sidecars must migrate ordinal grades to kind literals; Gerrit 1005 implements all four structural changes, ADR 0054 ratification, and pre-landing corpus replay bounds (worst-case +81 blocks across 1,396 findings).
